name: acid phosphatase 6, lysophosphatidic

function.text: ACP6 is the approved symbol for acid phosphatase 6, lysophosphatidic. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in lysophosphatidic acid phosphatase activity; lysobisphosphatidic acid metabolic process; phosphatidic acid biosynthetic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Adrenocortical carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: ACP6 encodes acid phosphatase 6, lysophosphatidic. Its functions include lysophosphatidic acid phosphatase activity and lysobisphosphatidic acid metabolic process.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACP6 have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
